description: Use after the form exists to get copy-paste html, astro, or next code that posts to /s/:publicKey. Do not invent a submit URL — this tool returns it. Snippets are single-value inputs; write checkbox groups and multi-selects yourself. Checkbox groups, select multiple, and other multi-value HTML fields must use a [] suffix on the name (name="services[]") or only the last checked value is stored. Put services[] on field_contract.name too. JSON/fetch should send a real array without brackets ({ "services": ["a", "b"] }) and must not use Object.fromEntries(formData) — use formData.getAll("services"). Single checkbox, select, or combobox: no brackets. File inputs use multipart POST (name="resume[]" for multiple). Enable uploads on the project first. Downloads are the project inbox at files_url, with the form slug as a folder — never put that URL in a public snippet. After dropping the snippet, add visitor-facing success UI: a thank-you page plus default_redirect_url for classic HTML POST, or an on-page message when using fetch/{ok:true}. Do not leave visitors looking at JSON. See furrow://docs/submit-success. Hardcode submit_url as returned; the public key is not a secret. Do not move it into .env / NEXT_PUBLIC_* / PUBLIC_* or ask the human to set environment variables. See furrow://docs/testing.

form_id.description: Form id from list_forms, create_form, or bootstrap_site.

framework.description: Snippet flavor: html (plain form), astro (component), or next (React client component).
